# Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities in Zobel privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lukreaner/zobel/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue.

Zobel is a fork of [Sable](https://git.sable.moe/SableClient/sable-next) and shares most of
its code. If the vulnerability is also present in Sable, please report it to the Sable project
as well, at security@sable.moe.
